english: The dark knight stands in the crypt.
You are no threat to him.
His armor creaks. His body moves.
He holds out a gauntlet towards the open tomb.
This guy scares the shit out of me, Snell whispers to you.
What do you... what do you mean?
(Hold out a hand towards the tomb.)
FEEL IT, SOLDIER, the windy voice barks at you.
It cradles here. Within this one point.
There is no question of the sanctity of this place.
But you have never understood it so well.
You attempt it, but the String feels overwhelming.
This is a fallen place. Corrupted. Full of dread...
The fear lies within your heart.
It is nothing compared to the sanctity of this place.
I'm not enough. I've never been enough.
And that is exactly what you are meant to be.
Something has changed within you. It reminds you of that cantrip you used to cast all the time.
Use Thaumaturgy to unveil sacred locations around the city.
The dark knight says nothing more. He simply picks up his axe, and leaves.
You hear him take the stairs, up to the Temple of Urth- leaving you alone in the crypts.
His master has told you to perform this act.
You know it. You understand it.
